evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
